# Koshirai researcher agent guide

README.md owns the end-to-end L0/L1/L2 process, reader roles and implementation
limits. benchmarks/README.md owns counting, reproducibility and comparisons.
Use those owners; do not duplicate their workflow or create another parser/queue.

One application lives in kanji_translator/. document_parser.py routes inputs;
image_regions.py and document_layout.py own structure; readers/ocr owns explicit
English, printed Japanese and historical Japanese adapters. Honkoku is an external
single-line comparison, not an implemented backend. Source inspection chooses
regions/scripts; do not claim automatic mixed-page dispatch or full-book translation.
Saved source-bound OCR comes first. Preserve engine/model/configuration hashes,
native coordinates, reading order and named original/corrected/normalized layers.

entry_structure.py owns explicit headings and era/province fields;
japanese_clauses.py owns source-span relationship proposals with polarity/modality;
semantic_groups.py owns grouping and interpretation; region_enrichment.py owns
lexical caching; scan_folder.py and research_corpus.py own scan/import. English
follows supported Japanese spans; never use a generated translation to repair OCR.

The four results are literal OCR/general meanings, complete expressions, cited
sword readings/English, and supported alternatives. Match complete spans with
original offsets and boxes. 雲次 can support Unji; 雲 alone cannot. 徳川 can support
Tokugawa as a family name without selecting a particular historical person.
Keep terms, schools, smith names, people, places, eras, measurements and unknowns
separate. Preserve quantities/units and source-asserted relations. A shared name
or repeated dealer record is not independent identity evidence.

PrimaryReference leads technical meanings; SupportingReference and registers
support names/relations. Cite the actual evidence. Separate Japanese/English
edition citations; two editions of one work are not independent votes. Keep
complete_candidate boundary evidence and withhold unsupported whole-compound glosses.
interpret_units retains offsets, shared cited meanings and oversized-unit holds.

Inspect original pixels before selecting a disputed reading. Preserve alternatives,
visible old forms and uncertainty. Agreement, confidence and dictionary plausibility
are not correctness proofs. Record the actual reviewer/model, crop and inspection
scope; never credit Sol or a human for an inspection they did not perform.
Qwen only assists stroke/shape inspection. It must not select meanings or identities.
BERT/Jev may propose supported roles or abstain; scores are uncalibrated.
frontier_semantics.py compares text semantics, not vision OCR. Live evaluation is
pending; do not describe it as a completed visual benchmark. No paid inference by default.

For comparisons, freeze independent source-only references and hold out whole works.
Run identical line crops and report full-page detection/reading-order errors separately.
Preserve literal-glyph and normalized scores, false positives, misses and abstentions.
Keep legacy area-overlap and native_line_projection_v1 grouping results reproducible.
AI references are provisional; do not claim expert English accuracy or a three-reader
manuscript win. Public results require permitted evidence and sufficient disclosed scope.

Install/use and data locations are in README.md; saved-OCR contracts are in
docs/researcher_guide.md. Use the installed Python environment. Inputs, outputs,
models and environments stay outside the checkout. No alternate corpus database.
Preserve source hashes, unique corrections, accepted receipts and idempotent imports.
Private originals, credentials, source identities/paths and passages never enter a release.
Public samples require reuse rights; external model licenses remain separate.

Every file needs a runtime, installation, verification, reproducibility, rights or
unique-evidence purpose. Human steering replaces old backlog. Verify callers and
successors before deleting obsolete routes; retain unique historical evidence compactly.
Edit existing owners. No new plans, checkpoint files, duplicate instructions or hooks.
Run appropriate checks, update the existing file-purpose inventory once, and scan
checkout, index and reachable history before publication. Stop auditing after acceptance.
